title: Short title.
bodyText: This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Hawaii International Arbitration, Mediation, and Conciliation Act.
bodyHtml:
[§658D-1]  Short title.  This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Hawaii International Arbitration, Mediation, and Conciliation Act. [L 1988, c 186, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "Chapter" substituted for "act" pursuant to §23G-15.
